1981.notes: 2% on residents (1% on nonresidents) through June 30, 1981; 3% on residents and 1.5% on nonresidents from July 1, 1981 (approved by city voters June 23, 1981 under PA 60 and 61 of 1981; Detroit City Code sec. 44-2-8 history: Ord. No. 460-H, eff. 7-1-1981; sec. 44-2-16 withholding at the new rate from July 1, 1981; the ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism 1981-82 edition, M-135, Table 31 note 12, lists Detroit at 3% for residents at December 31, 1982). No document states how the city treated the split calendar year (unlike 1999-2003, when it set blended calendar-year rates), so 1981 is recorded at the year-end rate, following the convention of the other Michigan files for mid-year changes (Saginaw 1989, Grand Rapids 2010).
